capabilities.name: tag.context.overview
capabilities.use: Confirm the nexus, the caller's role and that TAG is invited.

capabilities.name: aletia.search
capabilities.use: Locate requested documents and prior workpapers the caller may see.

capabilities.name: tag.ledger.transactions.read
capabilities.use: Populations and transaction detail for selections.

capabilities.name: tag.evidence.attach
capabilities.use: Record each evidence item, its hash and source against the run.

capabilities.name: tag.review.request
capabilities.use: Route the package for review before release.

inputs.name: organization, entity, period, requester and request list
inputs.source: TAG harness run context; request document via aletia.search

inputs.name: mode (general or SOX) and SOX scope confirmation
supporting documents
inputs.source: aletia.search or documents the user supplies

inputs.name: sample-size and materiality requirements
inputs.source: tag.policy.reporting.read or the examiner's written instructions

outputs.name: evidence index
outputs.description: One row per request with source, hash, status and gap.

outputs.name: workpapers
outputs.description: Population, selection, procedures, results and exceptions per area or test.

outputs.name: gap list
outputs.description: Missing or partial items with owners.

conditions: Before any evidence is released outside the organization.
Any conclusion on control effectiveness or deficiency severity is the qualified reviewer's, never the skill's.
SOX procedures only after the organization confirms it is in scope.
